payload.text: RELEASE AFTER NEXT, weigh only (found 2026-11-14 at Intent's 3.3.3 cut): a red remote leg's gate run directory sits under the leg's TMPDIR (<worktree>.tmp), which is removed with the worktree, so the failing test's output is lost and only 'cargo test --workspace failed; the run is in <gone path>' reaches the kept log. A failed leg should copy its failing gate's output into the kept log or keep the run dir. Related: archived todo 208.
